content: The main feature of the proposed baseline system is its flexibility with respect to the language considered. In fact, it only uses a list of language markers and the grammatical category of words. The first resource, although dependent on each language, is relatively easy to obtain. We have found that, even with lists of moderate size, the results are quite significant. The grammatical categories were obtained with the help of the TreeTagger statistics tool. However, TreeTagger could be replaced by any other tool producing similar results.
